scope: Read-only inventory of root model_on_r*_launch.json and their referenced output records. No simulator/model run, live process check, or wire-model verification.
limitations: Launch manifests are not equivalent to started or completed experiments.
A source/instance version path is not a semantic diff or independent scene.
Model labels describe launch requests, not independently verified provider internals.
Evaluation presence alone does not establish an audited autonomous episode.
Missing terminal evaluation does not establish simulator failure.
A stored running status does not establish a live process.
